newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on devaluation rumour.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on devaluation rumour.

text.p: Pakistani stocks slumped at Monday's close on selling pressure triggered on rumours that government plans a devaluation of the rupee against the dollar, dealers said.
"The sentiment is weak because past devaluations did not help Pakistan to boost its exports," dealer Shakil Anwar said. "Genuine investors, institutions and foreigners all are on the sidelines."
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 21.32 points, or 1.34 percent, to end at 1,569.98. Losers beat gainers 222 to 53. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
